professionalSummary.text: Candidate has extensive experience as a Performance Engineer for the credit monitoring platform, with a focus on designing load scenarios, analysing latency and capacity bottlenecks, and providing structured performance sign-off inputs for releases.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included load scenario design, bottleneck analysis, sign-off inputs and test-window coordination for the credit monitoring platform over about two years.

experienceHighlights.text: Designed load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.
experienceHighlights.witness: Designed the load scenarios for the utilisation batch and the early-warning online queries using the team's performance test platform, collecting CPU, memory and database wait metrics for each run.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Analysed latency distributions for the online queries and traced the p95 bottleneck to a missing index on the facility table, documented in the release performance report with the before-and-after measurements.

skills.text: Provided structured performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.
skills.witness: Provided the performance sign-off inputs for four releases as a structured checklist (scenarios run, thresholds met, open risks); the release approval stayed with the platform manager, who used the inputs at the change advisory board.
